errors.text: It fails to define the requested critical threshold of approximately 900 K.

It substitutes speculative temperature-dependent stacking-fault energy and dislocation climb for the target mechanism of declining dislocation density, increasing HCP/stacking-fault content, and rapid lattice disorder.
The stated temperature range of 300 K to above 500 K does not reconstruct the simulated 300, 600, 900, and 1200 K conditions.
The cited creep evidence does not directly validate nanoscale indentation or friction behavior in this FeNiCrCoCu coating-on-Cu system.
